name: Solarshades
text: Shade fabric over the shelter cuts direct solar load: 70% shade coverage, blocks 95% of UV, and 12" vent holes reduce wind lift. Six standard colours, fire retardant.

name: Interconnectors & corridors
text: Weather-protected links between shelters — from two buildings to a whole camp. Connect an operating room to central sterile supply, or a kitchen to dining, without stepping outside.

name: Weather protection covers
text: Weather protection covers are part of the accessory range alongside Solarshades and interconnectors. Ask the team which options suit your site.
